(It's me, I'm the dummy) When I first heard that a heatsink installation was needed to expand the memory of a PS5, I thought it would be a daunting task. Luckily Sabrent created this product that made it super easy.When I ordered the heatsink, it came with the thermal insulation pad already applied to the sink, and the box came with its own mini screwdriver to handle the tiny screws on the inside of my PS5. We're talking about screws that can fall through a kitchen strainer here! In the picture, you can see that the screwdriver is the size of a q-tip.Another thing that's very neat is that the heatsink is designed to fit the SSD slot perfectly, so there's no real way to make it fit the wrong way. On top of that, the heatsink will actually replace the cover to the slot that comes in the console. I put the stock cover in the box where the heatsink came so I don't lose it.So in summary, you put the new NVMe drive in, stick the heatsink on top, screw it in, and done.
